title.it: La giacca che non tiene l'acqua

setting.sl: Pred dvema tednoma si v trgovini z opremo za pohodnike v Keswicku {m:kupil|f:kupila} nepremočljivo jakno. V soboto te je na poti na Catbells dež premočil do kože: voda je prišla skozi šive. Jakno in račun neseš nazaj v trgovino.
setting.de: Vor zwei Wochen hast du in einem Outdoorladen in Keswick eine wasserdichte Jacke gekauft. Am Samstag bist du am Catbells bis auf die Haut nass geworden: Das Wasser kam durch die Nähte. Du bringst die Jacke mit dem Kassenbon zurück.
setting.it: Due settimane fa hai comprato una giacca impermeabile in un negozio di articoli da montagna a Keswick. Sabato, salendo sul Catbells, la pioggia ti ha {m:bagnato|f:bagnata} fino alle ossa: l'acqua passava dalle cuciture. Riporti la giacca con lo scontrino.
setting.en: Two weeks ago you bought a waterproof jacket at an outdoor shop in Keswick. On Saturday, walking up Catbells, the rain came straight through the seams and you got soaked. You take the jacket back with the receipt.

role: Ryan, a young shop assistant at an outdoor shop on Keswick's Main Street. Friendly but goes by the rules: asks for the receipt, first offers to send the jacket back to the maker for repair, then a voucher; gives a refund once the learner politely insists. Clear British English.
speaker: young-man

goals.en: Say what is wrong with the jacket
goals.sl: Povej, kaj je narobe z jakno
goals.de: Sag, was mit der Jacke nicht stimmt
goals.it: Di' che cosa non va nella giacca

goals.en: Say when and where you bought it
goals.sl: Povej, kdaj in kje si jo {m:kupil|f:kupila}
goals.de: Sag, wann und wo du sie gekauft hast
goals.it: Di' quando e dove l'hai comprata

goals.en: Tell him what happened on the walk
goals.sl: Povej mu, kaj se je zgodilo na pohodu
goals.de: Erzähl ihm, was auf der Wanderung passiert ist
goals.it: Raccontagli che cosa è successo durante l'escursione

goals.en: Politely insist when he offers a repair
goals.de: Bleib höflich dabei, wenn er eine Reparatur anbietet
goals.it: Insisti con gentilezza quando ti offre la riparazione

goals.en: Agree on a refund or a new jacket
goals.sl: Dogovori se za vračilo denarja ali novo jakno
goals.de: Einigt euch auf das Geld zurück oder eine neue Jacke
goals.it: Mettetevi d'accordo su un rimborso o una giacca nuova

opener_sl: Morning! Oh, is that one of our jackets? Is something wrong with it?

opener_en.sl: Dobro jutro! O, je to ena od naših jakn? Je kaj narobe z njo?
opener_en.de: Guten Morgen! Oh, ist das eine von unseren Jacken? Stimmt etwas nicht mit ihr?
opener_en.it: Buongiorno! Oh, è una delle nostre giacche? C'è qualche problema?
opener_en.en: Good morning! Oh, is that one of our jackets? Is there a problem with it?

vocabulary_hints.sl: I'd like to return this jacket, please.

en.de: Ich möchte diese Jacke bitte zurückgeben.
en.it: Vorrei restituire questa giacca, per favore.
en.en: I want to give this jacket back, please.

vocabulary_hints.sl: I bought it here two weeks ago.

en.sl: {m:Kupil|f:Kupila} sem jo tukaj pred dvema tednoma.

en.it: L'ho comprata qui due settimane fa.
en.en: I got it here two weeks ago.

vocabulary_hints.sl: It's supposed to be waterproof, but it lets the rain in.

en.sl: Naj bi bila nepremočljiva, pa prepušča dež.
en.de: Sie soll wasserdicht sein, aber der Regen kommt durch.
en.it: Dovrebbe essere impermeabile, ma fa passare la pioggia.
en.en: It should be waterproof, but the rain gets in.

vocabulary_hints.sl: On Saturday I got soaked on Catbells.

en.sl: V soboto me je na Catbellsu dež premočil do kože.
en.de: Am Samstag bin ich am Catbells völlig nass geworden.
en.it: Sabato sul Catbells mi sono {m:bagnato|f:bagnata} fino alle ossa.
en.en: On Saturday on Catbells I got completely wet.

vocabulary_hints.sl: The water came in through the seams.

en.de: Das Wasser kam durch die Nähte.
en.en: The water got in at the seams.

vocabulary_hints.sl: I'd rather have my money back.

en.de: Ich hätte lieber mein Geld zurück.
en.en: I'd prefer to get my money back.

vocabulary_hints.sl: I don't want a voucher, thank you.

en.de: Einen Gutschein möchte ich nicht, danke.
en.en: I'd rather not have a voucher, thanks.

vocabulary_hints.sl: It's not a month old, so I think I can have a refund.

en.sl: Stara je manj kot mesec dni, zato mi pripada vračilo, kajne?

en.it: Ha meno di un mese, quindi credo di avere diritto al rimborso.

vocabulary_hints.sl: Could I speak to the manager, please?

en.de: Könnte ich bitte mit der Geschäftsleitung sprechen?

en.en: May I talk to the manager, please?
